patterns.note: The site uses a dark, full-bleed background with content sections centered and often employing multi-column grids for features and information.
Prominent, wide sans-serif headings are paired with distinct monospace code examples to convey technical information clearly.
A high-contrast dark mode palette is used, featuring white text against a near-black background, accented by vibrant red for CTAs and various colors for code syntax highlighting.
A subtle, persistent particle animation serves as a dynamic background across multiple sections, complemented by animated code snippets that appear to 'type out' or change.
Feature sections are frequently presented as a grid of cards, each containing a title and a concise description, often accompanied by relevant code examples.

technique_notes: The site employs a persistent, subtle particle animation as a background across various sections, likely implemented with a canvas element, creating a dynamic yet unobtrusive visual texture.
Key technical information and examples are highlighted using animated code snippets that dynamically appear or change, drawing the user's attention to specific functionalities.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, contributing to a smooth and engaging scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, wide sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with standard sans-serif body text and distinct monospace code examples.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements, with subtle rounding on buttons and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, but tighter grids for feature cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, animated particle background combined with dynamic, syntax-highlighted code snippets directly integrated into the design creates a highly technical and sophisticated aesthetic. This approach effectively reinforces the 'invisible infra' concept by visually representing complex systems in an engaging and accessible manner.
